points: Monthly CVE disclosures rose from 5,045 in January to 10,740 in August
141 vulnerabilities exploited Jan-Aug 2026, more than all of 2025 (127)
50% of likely AI-discovered flaws allow remote code execution, versus 26% overall
take: AI-assisted discovery floods patch queues. GTIG says triage by exploitation evidence, not CVE volume, with edge devices and the AI stack first.
title: Google GTIG: monthly CVEs doubled in 2026, exploits up sharply
